name: export_parameter_bindings
description: Project: export all project parameter bindings and the full shared-parameter inventory to a JSON file on disk (written by the gateway; only a summary crosses MCP). Output contains bindings[] {name, isInstance, group, dataType, boundCategories[], guid, isShared} plus allSharedParameterElements[] {name, guid}. Used to GUID-verify the 2024 template's shared parameters against the extracted snapshot. Requires an active project document.
